basic_info.description: ||| Broker Tour and Open House Tuesday, 11/19, 1-3PM |||    1259 20th Avenue is a triplex in the Sunset District of San Francisco.    The property consists of two 2-bedroom/1-bathroom units (front and back) and a top-floor 3-bedroom/2-bathroom full floor flat. Built in 1984, the units in this modern triplex are in original condition. Ownership has recently painted the exterior and installed new water heaters. The top unit benefits from skylights, providing ample natural light. Additional highlights include a spacious backyard, fully sprinklered fire suppression system, and central heating. The 3-car garage offers a laundry room and extra storage space.    The property is located in a prime area near Irving Street. Irving Street is the Sunset District's premier retail corridor, serving residents and patrons of nearby Golden Gate Park with ethnic cuisines, upscale dining options, and highly rated retailers. The location has convenient access to multiple bus lines and MUNI's N-Judah light rail.    The investment appeal of the property is its excellent location.
